acceptance: For each applicable verified phase require both class counts and seed counts. Apply the UNKNOWN limit to observations targeted near switches/recovery, including failed evidence.

phase_evidence.clock: same connection and Linux monotonic epoch; separately validate probe/pcap clock mapping
phase_evidence.instrumentation: integrate per-run probes in both directions and independently check probe/trace perturbation before collection
phase_evidence.missing: UNKNOWN for every record in a run with absent or unreliable required switch/recovery evidence
phase_evidence.outage: independent probe sends, matching kernel drops and receives; verify outage and restoration in the affected direction
phase_evidence.phase_rule: last old to stable new is transition; verified stable outage ends at recovery lower bound; recovery through stable confirmation
phase_evidence.reversal: reuse dual-direction probe delay and ranking bounds; fixed rate per link; verify continuous new state
phase_evidence.scope: phase labels are offline-only; verify on the same XQUIC runs, not separate calibration repetitions

planning_endpoint: 0-25 ms same-record M3 minus M1 seed-equal Brier; planning approximation only
post_collection: Validate actual trajectory SHA-256, workload SHA-256 and connection identity by partition; retain failed/UNKNOWN runs.
preflight: Freeze real XQUIC build and verifier fingerprints; verify simultaneous probes under both load levels and recheck existing 5 ms error/skew and ±5% Goodput limits before acquisition.
status: frozen design; collection and development validation pending
stop_rule: Attempt each frozen seed once in manifest order; retain failures and stop after the fixed schedule. Any shortfall remains a failure of coverage.
